description: OrbbecSlicer QIFW packaging toolchain manifest. All tools are fetched into toolchainRoot (a path relative to the repository) and are never written outside this repository.

qt.note: aqt 3.3.0's downloader hits a read timeout on large archives when download.qt.io 302-redirects to the CDN, so Qt is fetched by fetch-qt-archives.ps1 using curl parallel download + official sha256 verification + py7zr extraction; equivalent to the result of aqt install-qt.

ifw.note: QIFW 4.11 is only published in the windows_x86/ifw/ channel, and aqt's target allowlist does not include ifw, so it cannot be fetched with aqt install-tool; fetch-ifw.ps1 downloads it directly via archiveUrl instead.

tools.name: binarycreator
tools.note: does not provide --version; --help prints Usage and exits 0, so the version is taken from the directory name (manifest.ifw.version)

tools.name: installerbase
tools.note: running it with no arguments prints 'No marker found' and exits non-zero; that is normal behavior and does not mean it is unavailable

verification.note: All archives are extracted only after passing verification against the official .sha256.
